spec.doc: StarTrack Label Specifications - Modify Your Own System (MOS) v9

MOS v9.title: StarTrack Label Specifications - Modify Your Own System (MOS)

Merchant profile.title: Merchant profile entered in the auditor

rules.title: StarTrack label dimensions
rules.description: Labels are 100 × 150 mm, or 100 × 200 mm, or 150 × 100 mm for returns. Size is only a note.

messages.pass: Page dimensions match an accepted StarTrack label size ({actual}).
messages.fail: Page size ({actual}) is not a standard StarTrack label size. Presentation note only - the label content is audited regardless.

rules.title: StarTrack logo/header
rules.description: The P-StarTrack logo sits top left. A decoded StarTrack barcode also confirms the label.

messages.pass: StarTrack label confirmed from a barcode or the header. Check the logo sits top left.
messages.fail: Couldn't confirm a StarTrack label: no StarTrack barcode was read and no StarTrack header was found. Check the logo on the label.

rules.title: Label code displayed in header
rules.description: The 3-character label code for the StarTrack product must appear above the logo (Premium: white on black; Express/Special Services: black on white).

messages.pass: Label/product code found in the printed label text: {actual}.
messages.fail: No 3-letter label code was read from the header. The barcodes carry the product, but the header must print it too. Check it on the label.
messages.missing: No 3-letter label code was read from the header. The barcodes carry the product, but the header must print it too. Check it on the label.

rules.title: Connote in header
rules.description: The consignment number must appear in the centre of the header under a CONNOTE: heading, catering for up to 20 characters.

messages.pass: Connote {value} is printed in the header.
messages.missing: No CONNOTE value was found. Check the header shows the connote under the CONNOTE: heading.

rules.title: Receiver address
rules.description: Receiver name, address, suburb, state and postcode must be displayed beneath the logo.

messages.pass: Receiver details found in the label text.
messages.missing: The receiver address wasn't found in the label text. Check it's printed under the logo.

rules.title: Sender details
rules.description: Sender name, phone and address must be displayed beneath the routing barcode.

messages.pass: Sender details found in the label text.
messages.missing: Sender details weren't found. Check the name, phone and address sit under the routing barcode.

rules.title: Printed postcodes match their states
rules.description: Each printed suburb line's postcode must belong to its state. Border towns that share a postcode are listed in reference-values.json.

rules.title: Weight displayed
rules.description: The consignment weight in kg must appear under the WEIGHT heading.

messages.pass: Weight value found in the printed label text: {actual} kg.
messages.fail: No weight was read from the label. The QR carries it, but the label must print it too. Check the WEIGHT value.
messages.missing: No weight was read from the label. The QR carries it, but the label must print it too. Check the WEIGHT value.

rules.title: Cubic volume displayed
rules.description: The consignment cubic volume in cubic metres must appear under the CUBE heading.

messages.pass: Cubic volume found in the printed label text: {actual} m3.
messages.fail: No cube was read from the label. The QR carries it, but the label must print it too. Check the CUBE value.
messages.missing: No cube was read from the label. The QR carries it, but the label must print it too. Check the CUBE value.

rules.title: StarTrack 2D QR barcode decoded
rules.description: Every label carries the StarTrack 2D QR barcode, holding the fixed-width consignment data.

messages.pass: StarTrack QR barcode read.

rules.title: QR fixed-width payload length
rules.description: The QR is fixed width: 290 characters, or 334 with the optional fields.

messages.pass: The QR is {actual} characters, matching the fixed-width layout.
messages.fail: The QR is only {actual} characters. It should be at least 290, so some fields below may be cut short or shifted.

rules.title: Source image resolution
rules.description: Raster label images need roughly 300 DPI for reliable linear barcode decoding. Low-resolution exports collapse the narrow bars and spaces, destroying the encoded data.

messages.pass: Estimated image resolution is about {actual} DPI, which should be sufficient for barcode decoding.
messages.fail: Estimated image resolution is about {actual} DPI (assuming a standard 100mm label edge). Linear barcodes are typically unrecoverable below about 200 DPI - upload the original PDF or export the label at 300 DPI or higher.

rules.title: Freight item barcode decoded
rules.description: The 20-character StarTrack Code 128 freight item barcode must be present on every article.

messages.pass: StarTrack Code 128 freight item barcode(s) decoded.

rules.title: Routing barcode decoded
rules.description: An approved sortation barcode must be present: the StarTrack routing barcode, or the GS1 421 routing barcode for SSCC labels.

args.label: A StarTrack routing barcode (or GS1 421 routing barcode)

messages.pass: Routing barcode(s) decoded.

rules.title: Despatch ID
rules.description: The freight item barcode must start with the 4-character alphanumeric despatch ID issued by StarTrack.

messages.fail: Despatch ID {actual} must be 4 letters or digits.

rules.title: Freight barcode despatch ID structure
rules.description: The despatch ID's 3rd character is a letter and its 4th is Z, e.g. ABCZ. From StarTrack's integration team.
rules.expectedText: 3rd character a letter, 4th Z, e.g. ABCZ

messages.pass: Despatch ID {actual} is correctly structured (3rd character alphabetic, 4th character Z).
messages.fail: Despatch ID {actual} is malformed. The 3rd character must be A-Z and the 4th must be Z.

rules.title: Despatch ID belongs to this merchant
rules.description: Every despatch ID on the label, in the freight barcode and the QR connote, must be one the merchant profile lists. Runs only when a profile is entered.

messages.pass: Despatch ID {actual} is in the merchant profile.
messages.fail: Despatch ID {actual} isn't in the merchant profile ({expected}). StarTrack issues despatch IDs per customer site, so check this label uses the merchant's own.

rules.title: Connote digits
rules.description: Characters 5-12 of the freight barcode are the 8-digit consignment sequence.

messages.fail: Connote digits {actual} must be 8 digits.

rules.title: Item number
rules.description: The final 5 characters of the freight barcode are the numeric item sequence within the consignment.

messages.fail: Item number {actual} must be 5 digits.

rules.title: Freight product code
rules.description: Characters 13-15 of the freight barcode must be a valid StarTrack product code.

messages.fail: Product code {actual} isn't a StarTrack product.

rules.title: Code 128 compression structure
rules.description: The freight barcode reads 4 characters, 8 digits, 3 characters, then 5 digits.

messages.pass: Decoded freight barcode structure is consistent with the required Code B/C compression pattern: {actual}.
messages.fail: Decoded freight barcode structure does not match the Code B/C compression pattern (4 alphanumeric + 8 digits + 3 alphanumeric + 5 digits): {actual}.

rules.title: Symbol bar count (compression evidence)
rules.description: A compressed freight barcode prints 61 bars; an uncompressed one prints 70. Image quality can skew the count.

messages.pass: Measured {actual} bars, matching the 61 bars expected of a compression-encoded freight item barcode.
messages.fail: Measured {actual} bars where a compression-encoded freight item barcode prints exactly 61 (an uncompressed all-Code-B symbol prints 70). Verify the symbol's Code B/C encodation with a barcode verifier; low image quality can also distort this count.
messages.missing: The bar count could not be measured reliably from this image (low contrast or inconsistent scanlines across the symbol), so the Code B/C compression could not be confirmed. This usually indicates a scan quality issue - upload the original PDF or a 300 DPI export, or verify the symbol's encodation with a barcode verifier.

rules.title: Product fits the label type
rules.description: The product code in the freight barcode must belong to the product family selected for this audit.
rules.expectedText: A product for this label type: {expected}

messages.fail: Product {actual} doesn't belong to this label type.

rules.title: Visible connote matches freight barcode
rules.description: The CONNOTE value printed in the header must equal the connote embedded in the freight item barcode. Compared against print-only text so the barcode cannot vouch for itself.

messages.pass: Printed CONNOTE matches the freight barcode connote.
messages.fail: The printed CONNOTE does not match the connote embedded in the freight item barcode ({actual}). Check it on the label. Overlays and watermarks can throw off text reading.
messages.skipped: No printed CONNOTE was read, so it couldn't be compared with the freight barcode.

rules.title: Routing label code
rules.description: The first three characters of the routing barcode must be a valid StarTrack label code.

messages.fail: Label code {actual} isn't a StarTrack label code.

rules.title: Routing postcode
rules.description: Characters 4-7 of the routing barcode must be the four-digit receiver postcode (9901 for NZ Premium).

messages.fail: Routing postcode {actual} must be 4 digits.

rules.title: Routing and product compatibility
rules.description: The routing label code must match the product in the freight barcode or QR, e.g. FPP routes as PRM and FPA as ARL.

messages.skipped: No product was read from a freight barcode or the QR, so the routing label code couldn't be checked against it.

rules.title: Routing and QR postcodes match
rules.description: The routing barcode postcode must equal the QR receiver postcode.

messages.skipped: No receiver postcode was read from the QR, so the routing postcode couldn't be compared.
messages.fail: Routing postcode {actual} doesn't match the QR postcode ({expected}).

rules.title: Code 128 compression structure
rules.description: The routing barcode reads 3 characters, 4 digits, then 2 or 3 characters. Only a verifier can confirm the encoding.

messages.pass: Decoded routing barcode structure is consistent with the required Code B/C compression pattern: {actual}.
messages.fail: Decoded routing barcode structure does not match the Code B/C compression pattern (3 alphanumeric + 4 digits + 2-3 alphanumeric): {actual}.

rules.title: Depot/port requires manual validation
rules.description: Depots come from StarTrack's Location Master File. Without it loaded, each routing barcode is held for review.

rules.title: Delivery location is in the Location Master File
rules.description: StarTrack delivers only to suburbs and postcodes in its Location Master File. Runs only when the file is loaded.

rules.title: Routing depot matches the Location Master File
rules.description: The routing barcode's depot must be the file's Nearest Depot for Express and Special Services, or its Primary Port for Premium products.

rules.title: QR destination depot matches the Location Master File
rules.description: QR field 15 must be the file's Nearest Depot for Express and Special Services, or its Secondary Port for Premium products.

rules.title: QR mandatory fields populated
rules.description: All mandatory fixed-width QR fields must be populated: receiver suburb/postcode/name/address, connote, freight item, product, quantity, weight, despatch date, unit type, destination depot, DG indicator and movement type.

messages.empty: No StarTrack QR barcode was read, so its mandatory fields couldn't be checked.

rules.title: QR receiver suburb
rules.description: QR field 1 must carry the receiver suburb (up to 30 characters) and must not be blank.

messages.missing: QR field 1, receiver suburb, is blank. It's mandatory.

rules.title: QR receiver postcode
rules.description: QR field 2 must be a four-digit postcode (9901 for NZ Premium).

messages.fail: QR field 2, postcode {actual}, must be 4 digits.
messages.missing: QR field 2, receiver postcode, is blank.

rules.title: QR connote
rules.description: QR field 3 must follow the connote format: 4-character despatch ID plus 8 digits.

messages.fail: QR field 3, connote {actual}, must be 4 characters then 8 digits.
messages.missing: QR field 3, connote, is blank.

rules.title: QR consignment despatch ID structure
rules.description: The QR connote opens with a despatch ID whose 3rd character is a letter and 4th is Z.
rules.expectedText: Despatch ID with a letter 3rd and Z 4th, e.g. ABCZ

messages.pass: Consignment number {actual} opens with a correctly structured despatch ID.
messages.fail: Consignment number {actual} has a malformed despatch ID. The 3rd character must be A-Z and the 4th must be Z.

rules.title: QR freight item
rules.description: QR field 4 must be the 20-character freight item identifier: despatch ID + 8-digit connote sequence + 3-character product + 5-digit item sequence.

messages.fail: QR field 4, freight item {actual}, must be 20 characters in the freight barcode format.
messages.missing: QR field 4, freight item, is blank.

rules.title: QR freight item despatch ID structure
rules.description: The QR freight item opens with a despatch ID whose 3rd character is a letter and 4th is Z.
rules.expectedText: Despatch ID with a letter 3rd and Z 4th, e.g. ABCZ

messages.pass: Freight item number {actual} opens with a correctly structured despatch ID.
messages.fail: Freight item number {actual} has a malformed despatch ID. The 3rd character must be A-Z and the 4th must be Z.

rules.title: QR product
rules.description: QR field 5 must be a valid StarTrack product code.

messages.fail: QR field 5, product {actual}, isn't a StarTrack product.
messages.missing: QR field 5, product, is blank.

rules.title: QR product fits label type
rules.description: The QR product code must belong to the product family selected for this audit.
rules.expectedText: A product for this label type: {expected}

messages.fail: QR product {actual} doesn't belong to this label type.
messages.missing: The QR product is blank, so it can't be matched to the label type.

rules.title: QR payer account
rules.description: QR field 6 (payer account) is required for controlled returns and transfers, and for third-party-paid despatch consignments.

messages.pass: Payer account is populated for this return/transfer movement: {actual}.
messages.fail: Movement type indicates a controlled return or transfer, but the payer account field is blank.
messages.missing: Movement type indicates a controlled return or transfer, but the payer account field is blank.

rules.title: QR sender account
rules.description: QR field 7 (sender account) is required for despatch movements and must be left-justified.

messages.pass: Sender account is populated for this despatch movement: {actual}.
messages.fail: Movement type indicates a despatch, but the sender account field is blank.
messages.missing: Movement type indicates a despatch, but the sender account field is blank.

rules.title: Sender account belongs to this merchant
rules.description: The QR sender account must be one of the merchant's StarTrack accounts. Runs only when a profile is entered.

messages.pass: Sender account {actual} is in the merchant profile.
messages.fail: Sender account {actual} isn't one of the merchant's StarTrack accounts ({expected}).

rules.title: Payer account is known
rules.description: A payer account outside the merchant profile is allowed when a third party pays, so it's flagged for review rather than failed.

messages.pass: Payer account {actual} is in the merchant profile.
messages.fail: Payer account {actual} isn't one of the merchant's accounts. That's fine if a third party pays, so confirm who pays.

rules.title: QR quantity
rules.description: QR field 8 must be a numeric consignment quantity of at least 1.

messages.fail: QR field 8, quantity {actual}, must be a whole number from 1.
messages.missing: QR field 8, quantity, is blank.

rules.title: QR weight
rules.description: QR field 9 must be the total consignment weight in whole kilograms, rounded up.

messages.fail: QR field 9, weight {actual}, must be whole kilograms from 1.
messages.missing: QR field 9, weight, is blank.

rules.title: QR consignment cube
rules.description: QR field 10 carries the consignment cubic volume as cubic metres x 1000 (or ***** on overflow). It is required for all non-satchel unit types.

messages.pass: Consignment cube populated: {actual}.
messages.fail: Consignment cube must be a numeric m3 x 1000 value (or ***** on overflow): {actual}.
messages.missing: Unit type is not a satchel, but the consignment cube field is blank.

rules.title: QR receiver name
rules.description: QR field 12 must carry the receiver name (up to 40 characters) and must not be blank.

messages.missing: QR field 12, receiver name, is blank. It's mandatory.

rules.title: QR unit type permitted
rules.description: QR field 14 must be an Appendix A unit type permitted for the product code.

rules.title: QR destination depot
rules.description: QR field 15 must carry the destination depot (Nearest Depot for Express, Secondary Port for Premium, ZNA for NZ) and must not be blank.

messages.missing: QR field 15, destination depot, is blank. It's mandatory.

rules.title: QR receiver address
rules.description: QR field 16 must carry receiver address line 1 (up to 40 characters, left-justified) and must not be blank.

messages.missing: QR field 16, receiver address, is blank. It's mandatory.

rules.title: QR receiver phone
rules.description: QR field 18 (receiver phone) is optional; when populated it must be numeric.

messages.pass: Receiver phone is numeric: {actual}.
messages.fail: Receiver phone should be numeric: {actual}.

rules.title: QR DG flag
rules.description: QR field 19 must be Y or N.

messages.fail: QR field 19 must be Y or N, not {actual}.
messages.missing: QR field 19, DG flag, is blank.

rules.title: QR movement type
rules.description: QR field 20 must be N (despatch), C (controlled return) or T (transfer).

messages.fail: QR field 20 must be N, C or T, not {actual}.
messages.missing: QR field 20, movement type, is blank.

rules.title: QR ATL number
rules.description: When populated, QR field 23 must use the C999999999 ATL format.

messages.fail: ATL number {actual} must be C followed by 9 digits.

rules.title: RA number required for returns and transfers
rules.description: QR field 24 (RA/TA number) is mandatory when the movement type is C (controlled return) or T (transfer).

messages.pass: RA/TA number is populated for this return/transfer movement: {actual}.
messages.fail: Movement type indicates a controlled return or transfer, but the RA/TA number field is blank.
messages.missing: Movement type indicates a controlled return or transfer, but the RA/TA number field is blank.

rules.title: Return or transfer marker
rules.description: Controlled returns and transfer movements must display a *RETURN* or *TRANSFER* indicator in the centre of the label header.

messages.pass: Return/transfer indicator found on the label: {actual}.
messages.missing: The QR says this is a return or transfer, but *RETURN* or *TRANSFER* wasn't found in the header.

rules.title: ATL barcode present when expected
rules.description: When the label or QR shows Authority To Leave, the C999999999 ATL barcode must be printed in the header.

messages.pass: ATL barcode decoded as expected.
messages.fail: Authority To Leave is indicated on the label, but no C999999999 ATL barcode was decoded.

rules.title: ATL counter
rules.description: The ATL barcode counter must start from 000000001.

messages.fail: ATL counter {actual} is invalid. Counters start at 000000001.

rules.title: ATL barcode matches
rules.description: The ATL barcode must equal the ATL number in the QR and any printed ATL text.
rules.expectedText: The QR or printed ATL number ({expected})

messages.fail: ATL barcode {actual} doesn't match the ATL number in the QR or printed text ({expected}).

rules.title: Code 128 compression structure
rules.description: The ATL barcode reads C followed by 9 digits.

messages.pass: Decoded ATL barcode structure is consistent with the required Code B/C compression pattern: {actual}.
messages.fail: Decoded ATL barcode structure does not match the Code B/C compression pattern (literal C + 9 digits): {actual}.

rules.title: QR connote matches barcode
rules.description: The QR connote must equal the connote in the freight item barcode.

messages.skipped: No freight item barcode was decoded, so the QR connote could not be cross-checked against it.
messages.fail: QR connote {actual} doesn't match the freight barcode connote ({expected}).

rules.title: QR item matches barcode
rules.description: The QR freight item number must equal the 20-character freight item barcode.

messages.skipped: No freight item barcode was decoded, so the QR freight item number could not be cross-checked against it.
messages.fail: QR freight item {actual} doesn't match the freight barcode ({expected}).

rules.title: Visible article ID matches freight barcode
rules.description: The human-readable article/freight item ID printed with the barcode must equal the decoded 20-character freight item value. Compared against print-only text so the barcode cannot vouch for itself.

messages.pass: Printed article ID matches the decoded freight item barcode.
messages.fail: The printed article ID does not match the decoded freight item barcode ({actual}). Check it on the label. Overlays and watermarks can throw off text reading.
messages.skipped: No printed article ID was read, so it couldn't be compared with the freight barcode.

rules.title: Linear barcode decoded but not recognised
rules.description: A linear barcode read fine but matches no StarTrack format. It may be malformed or from another system.

messages.fail: A linear barcode read as "{actual}" but matches no StarTrack format. Check it on the label: it may be malformed or from another system.

rules.title: Unexpected SSCC barcode on a standard label
rules.description: An SSCC barcode on a standard label can send the freight the wrong way.

messages.pass: No unexpected SSCC barcode is present on this standard label.
messages.fail: A valid AI 00 SSCC barcode was decoded on a label audited as a standard consignment label. Confirm the label format selection and the printed symbols.
